intent_contract.text: 다리를 벌리고 널부러지듯 뒷좌석에 뒤로 기대어있게 작성해줘.

Revise the existing adult bunny-girl moving-van photograph so she remains at the middle of the rear bench but leans deeply back in a loose sprawled posture with her legs visibly spread, while the established happy overwhelmed expression and double-peace gesture remain intact.

A high-energy editorial photograph of an unmistakably adult bunny-girl performer sprawled across the center position of the rear bench seat in a moving compact van. She is visibly in her mid-twenties, with mature facial structure and adult proportions. She wears a sleek black satin bunny suit, opaque tights, a white collar, wrist cuffs, tall rabbit ears, and ankle boots. Her shoulders and hips sink against the rear backrest as she leans deeply backward, with the center three-point seat belt crossing her torso. Her thighs angle apart, both knees remain widely separated, and each booted foot stays planted on the van floor, creating a loose open-legged posture. She raises both hands beside her cheeks, each hand forming a clear V sign with separated index and middle fingers, creating a symmetrical double-peace pose. Her expression is an exaggerated overwhelmed display: eyes visibly rolled upward and slightly crossed, tongue extended, cheeks flushed, and mouth open in theatrical happiness. Photograph her from the front-center aisle looking back toward the rear bench in a wide seated full-body frame, with her face, both hands, reclined torso, separated knees, and both planted feet visible together. Through both side windows, streaked roadside lights and directional motion blur establish that the van is traveling at speed, while direct on-camera flash keeps the passenger, seat belt, upholstery, and costume sharply frozen. Use a close wide-angle documentary-fashion aesthetic, centered depth composition, crisp skin texture, glossy fabric highlights, and playful nightlife energy.
